fieldValues.title: Sibling tasks of one issue are built in parallel and collide on one file
fieldValues.summary: srs#979, #980 and #981 are tasks of srs#977 built by separate sessions at the same time; all three append to conformance/arrangement/scenarios.json and its README. #979 and #981 merged; #980 went DIRTY and needed a rebase. srs-rust#1487 likewise had to be rebased onto #1485 to recount error variants.
evidence: srs-rust#1487 commit 'test(error): count both new variants after rebase onto #1485'
fieldValues.body:
- The desk counts a sequence's next task as free once the previous one is claimed, so siblings are taken in parallel even when they edit the same file.
- One growing JSON file that every task appends to makes the collision certain; RFC-051 split container membership into one file per entry for the same reason.
